
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/guxuanqing/p/19451115" title="发布于 2026-01-07 11:03">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">缓存行</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="Y3BBE" data-sfc-cp="" data-hveid="CAEIARAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">
<div data-subtree="aimfl" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">在系统级编程（Rust/C++/Go）中，<strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">缓存行（Cache Line）</strong> 是<strong>决定程序性能的物理底线</strong>。如果说算法决定了指令的数量，那么缓存行就决定了这些指令获取数据的时间。说真的，可以说大部分程序猿只会用，而不知道底层逻辑和细节。这在偏底层编程中，性能问题和内存泄漏问题越发常见。给自己挖坑，同时也潜在的给别人挖坑。知其然知其所以然，下面带领大家深入解析缓存底层细节和逻辑，理论与应用结合讲解以便看得明白，理解更深刻。<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_c/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_d,YTTUMb_e" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_c/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></div>
<h3 data-subtree="aimfl" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">1.缓存</h3>
<div data-subtree="aimfl" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">
<div class="Y3BBE" data-sfc-cp="" data-hveid="CAEIARAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">在当前一些处理器架构（如 Intel 第 16 代核心或 ARM v9.5 架构）中，L1 Cache两个 L1 缓存，分别被称为&nbsp;<span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">L1I (Instruction Cache，<strong>指令缓存</strong>)&nbsp;和&nbsp;<span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">L1D (Data Cache，<strong>数据缓存</strong>)。这种将指令和数据分开存储的架构被称为&nbsp;<span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">哈佛架构（Harvard Architecture）。</span></span></span></div>
<div class="Y3BBE" data-sfc-cp="" data-hveid="CAEIAxAA" data-processed="true" data-complete="true">以下是详细解析：</div>
<h4>1）. 为什么 L1 要拆成两个？</h4>
<div class="Y3BBE" data-sfc-cp="" data-hveid="CAEIBRAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">L1 缓存紧贴 CPU 核心（Core），是性能的最前线。拆分的根本目的是<span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">消除性能瓶颈：</span></div>
<ul class="KsbFXc U6u95" data-processed="true" data-complete="true">
<li data-hveid="CAEIBhAA" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">并行访问：CPU 在执行指令的同时，需要读取或写入数据。如果指令和数据混在一起，CPU 核心的“取指单元”和“执行单元”就会争抢同一个缓存端口。拆分后，取指令和读写数据可以<span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">同时进行，互不干扰。</span></span></span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEIBhAB" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">物理特性不同：</span></span></span>
<ul class="KsbFXc U6u95" data-complete="true">
<li data-hveid="CAEIBhAC" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">L1I (指令缓存)：通常是<span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">只读的（程序运行过程中指令很少改变），因此不需要复杂的缓存一致性写入逻辑，设计可以更简单。</span></span></span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEIBhAD" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">L1D (数据缓存)：必须支持<span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">频繁读写，需要复杂的电路来保证多核之间的数据同步。</span></span></span>&nbsp;</li>

</ul>

</li>

</ul>
<h4 class="otQkpb" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">2）. L1I 和 L1D 的存储方式</h4>
<div class="Y3BBE" data-sfc-cp="" data-hveid="CAEICBAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">虽然它们功能不同，但它们的底层存储单位<span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">依然是“缓存行”（Cache Line）：</span></div>
<ul class="KsbFXc U6u95" data-processed="true" data-complete="true">
<li data-hveid="CAEICRAA" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">标准统一：无论是 L1I 还是 L1D，内部都是由 64 字节（或某些高性能架构下的 128 字节）的缓存行组成的。</span></span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEICRAB" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">大小对称：在大多数主流 CPU 中，L1I 和 L1D 通常大小相等（例如各有 32KB 或 48KB），共同组成该核心的 L1 缓存。</span></span></li>

</ul>
<h4 class="otQkpb" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">3）. 三级缓存的全局视角</h4>
<div class="Y3BBE" data-sfc-cp="" data-hveid="CAEICxAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">在现代 CPU 中，这种“分分合合”的结构如下：</div>
<ul class="KsbFXc U6u95" data-processed="true" data-complete="true">
<li data-hveid="CAEIDBAA" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">L1 层级：<span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">拆分为 L1I（指令）和 L1D（数据）。</span></span></span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEIDBAB" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">L2 层级：<span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">统一（Unified）。不再区分指令和数据，一个核心独占一个 L2。</span></span></span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEIDBAC" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">L3 层級：<span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">统一（Unified）。所有核心共享，容量最大。</span></span></span></li>

</ul>

</div>

</div>
<div class="Fsg96" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"></div>
<h4 class="otQkpb" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">4）. 缓存行物理本质：CPU 读取内存的最小单位<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_l/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_m,YTTUMb_n" data-complete="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_l/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></h4>
<div class="Y3BBE" data-sfc-cp="" data-hveid="CAEIBBAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">CPU 并不是按字节从内存（RAM）读取数据的。为了效率，它每次会拉取一块固定大小的内存块到缓存中，这个块就是<strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">缓存行</strong>。</div>
<div class="Y3BBE" data-sfc-cp="" data-hveid="CAEIBBAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"><strong><span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">缓存行（Cache Line）是 L1 cache、L2 cache和 L3 缓存共享的最小存储与传输单位<span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">。</span></span></strong><span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_q/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_r,YTTUMb_s" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_q/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></div>
<ul class="KsbFXc U6u95" data-processed="true" data-complete="true">
<li data-hveid="CAEIBRAA" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">标准大小</strong>：在绝大多数 x86_64（Intel/AMD）和 ARM64（Apple M1/M2/M3/M4, 骁龙）处理器中，一个缓存行的大小固定为 <strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">64 字节</strong>。</span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEIBRAB" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">读取机制</strong>：即使你只想读取一个 1 字节的 <code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">u8</code>，CPU 也会将该字节所在的连续 64 字节整块加载。<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_12/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_13,YTTUMb_14" data-complete="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_12/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></span></li>

</ul>
<div class="Fsg96" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"></div>
<div class="Y3BBE" data-sfc-cp="" data-hveid="CAEICRAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"><strong>缓存行物理结构模型</strong>：<br data-serialized-params="[]" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">一个缓存行通常包含两个部分：</span></div>
<ul>
<li data-hveid="CAEIChAA" data-complete="true"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">Tag（标签）：存储这行数据对应的内存地址信息（相当于集装箱的物流单号）。</span></span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEIChAB" data-complete="true"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><span class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">Data（数据）：实际的 64 字节原始数据。</span></span></li>

</ul>
<h3 class="otQkpb" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">2. 为什么需要缓存行？（空间局部性）<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_17/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_18,YTTUMb_19" data-complete="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_17/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></h3>
<div class="Y3BBE" data-sfc-cp="" data-hveid="CAEIBxAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">缓存行的存在基于一个核心假设：<strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">空间局部性（Spatial Locality）</strong>。<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_1c/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_1d,YTTUMb_1e" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_1c/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></div>
<ul class="KsbFXc U6u95" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">
<li data-hveid="CAEICBAA" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true">如果你访问了内存地址 <code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">0x100</code>，那么你极大概率紧接着会访问 <code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">0x101</code>、<code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">0x102</code>。</span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEICBAB" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true">通过一次性加载 64 字节，当你访问后续数据时，它们已经在 L1 缓存中了，延迟从 <strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">~100ns（内存）</strong> 降到了 <strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">~1ns（L1 缓存）</strong>。<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_1p/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_1q,YTTUMb_1r" data-complete="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_1p/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></span></li>


</ul>
<div class="Fsg96" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"></div>
<h3 class="otQkpb" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">3. 性能陷阱：伪共享（False Sharing）<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_1u/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_1v,YTTUMb_1w" data-complete="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_1u/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></h3>
<div class="Y3BBE" data-sfc-cp="" data-hveid="CAEIChAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">这是多核并行编程中最隐蔽的性能杀手。<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_1y/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_1z,YTTUMb_20" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_1y/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></div>
<ul class="KsbFXc U6u95" data-processed="true" data-complete="true">
<li data-hveid="CAEICxAA" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">现象</strong>：两个线程（运行在两个核心上）分别修改两个<strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">完全无关</strong>的变量 <code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">A</code> 和 <code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">B</code>。</span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEICxAB" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">冲突</strong>：如果 <code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">A</code> 和 <code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">B</code> 恰好分配在<strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">同一个缓存行</strong>内，当核心 1 修改 <code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">A</code> 时，会强制将核心 2 缓存中的整行标记为失效（Invalid）。</span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEICxAC" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">后果</strong>：核心 2 必须重新从内存加载这一行才能读取 <code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">B</code>。两个核心像是在抢一个皮球，导致并行性能甚至不如单核。</span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEICxAD" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">解决方案</strong>：使用 Rust 中的 <code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">#[repr(align(64))]</code> 或 C++ 中的 <code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">alignas(64)</code> 将变量隔开。<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_2o/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_2p,YTTUMb_2q" data-complete="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_2o/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></span></li>


</ul>
<div class="Fsg96" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"></div>
<h3 class="otQkpb" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">4. 数据布局的影响：连续 vs 分散<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_2t/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_2u,YTTUMb_2v" data-complete="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_2t/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></h3>
<div class="Fsg96" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"></div>
<div class="AdPoic" data-animation-nesting="" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-sae="">A. 数组/Vec（缓存友好）<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_2y/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_2z,YTTUMb_30" data-complete="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_2y/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></div>
<div class="Y3BBE" data-sfc-cp="" data-hveid="CAEIDhAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">在 Rust 中，<code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">Vec&lt;u8&gt;</code> 或 <code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">[u32; N]</code> 是连续存放的。<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_34/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_35,YTTUMb_36" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_34/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></div>
<ul class="KsbFXc U6u95" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">
<li data-hveid="CAEIDxAA" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true">读取第 1 个元素时，后续的 15 个 <code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">u32</code> 已经随着缓存行进入了 CPU。</span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEIDxAB" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true">这就是为什么𝑂(𝑛)遍历数组往往比𝑂(1)查找逻辑复杂的离散结构更快。 </span></span>
<div data-xpm-copy-root=""><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/800081/202510/800081-20251028144910334-1234988547.gif" data-xpm-latex="O(n)" data-imglogged="true" data-sae=""></div>
</li>


</ul>
<div class="Fsg96" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"></div>
<div class="AdPoic" data-animation-nesting="" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-sae="">B. 链表/指针跳转（缓存地狱）<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_3k/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_3l,YTTUMb_3m" data-complete="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_3k/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></div>
<div class="Y3BBE" data-sfc-cp="" data-hveid="CAEIERAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">链表的节点散落在堆内存中。<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_3o/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_3p,YTTUMb_3q" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_3o/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></div>
<ul class="KsbFXc U6u95" data-processed="true">
<li data-hveid="CAEIEhAA" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true">每访问一个节点 <code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">node.next</code>，CPU 都必须跳到新的地址，这大概率会触发 <strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">Cache Miss</strong>。</span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEIEhAB" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true">这种“指针跳转（Pointer Chasing）”会迫使 CPU 停下来等待内存返回数据。<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_3y/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_3z,YTTUMb_40" data-complete="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_3y/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></span></li>


</ul>
<div class="Fsg96" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"></div>
<h3 class="otQkpb" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">5. 程序员的优化策略<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_43/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_44,YTTUMb_45" data-complete="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_43/TKHnVd" data-sae=""></span></span></h3>
<ul>
<li data-hveid="CAEIFBAA" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">结构体紧凑化</strong>：将经常一起访问的字段定义在一起，确保它们能落在同一个 64 字节的范围内。</span></span>
<div class="r1PmQe" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_4b,YTTUMb_4c,YTTUMb_4d" data-hveid="CAEIFBAB" data-complete="true">
<div data-complete="true">
<div class="pHpOfb" data-animation-atomic="" data-sae="">
<div class="pCTyYe" dir="ltr">
<pre><code><span class="mexSqb">struct<span class="undefined"> HotData {
    id: u64,         <span class="ClTQqc">// 8 字节<span class="undefined">
    status: u32,     <span class="ClTQqc">// 4 字节<span class="undefined">
    last_tick: u64,  <span class="ClTQqc">// 8 字节<span class="undefined">
    <span class="ClTQqc">// 总计 20 字节，远小于 64 字节，一个缓存行就能装下<span class="undefined">
}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="zyTWof-YAxtVc"><span class="MMvswb"><span class="OLCwg"></span></span></div>
</div>
<span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"></span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEIFBAD" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">避免跨行步长</strong>：在处理大矩阵或长向量时，尽量按行访问而非按列访问。</span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEIFBAE" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">对齐处理</strong>：对于跨线程共享的原子变量，确保它们位于不同的缓存行，防止伪共享。</span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEIFBAF" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">VecDeque 的优势</strong>：正如你之前关注的，<code class="o8j0Mc" dir="ltr" data-complete="true" data-sae="">VecDeque</code> 虽然在删除时移动内存，但它是在连续的内存块内移动。利用 CPU 的 <strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">预取器（Prefetcher）</strong>，这种移动在硬件层面是被高度优化的。<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_4r/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_4s,YTTUMb_4t" data-complete="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_4r/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></span></li>


</ul>
<div class="Fsg96" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"></div>
<h3 class="otQkpb" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">6. 性能数据参考<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_4w/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_4x,YTTUMb_4y" data-complete="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_4w/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></h3>
<div class="Y3BBE" data-sfc-cp="" data-hveid="CAEIFhAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">在高端处理器上：<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_50/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_51,YTTUMb_52" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_50/TKHnVd" data-sae=""><br></span></span></div>
<ul class="KsbFXc U6u95" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">
<li data-hveid="CAEIFxAA" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">L1 Cache 命中</strong>：约 3-4 个周期（极快）。</span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEIFxAB" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">L2 Cache 命中</strong>：约 12-15 个周期。</span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEIFxAC" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">L3 Cache 命中</strong>：约 40-60 个周期。</span></li>
<li data-hveid="CAEIFxAD" data-complete="true" data-sae=""><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-complete="true"><strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">主内存（RAM）</strong>：<strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true">200-400 个周期</strong>。<span class="txxDge notranslate" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_5h/R4Tih" data-wiz-uids="YTTUMb_5i,YTTUMb_5j" data-complete="true"><span class="vKEkVd" data-animation-atomic="" data-wiz-attrbind="class=YTTUMb_5h/TKHnVd" data-sae="">&nbsp;</span></span></span></li>


</ul>
<div class="Y3BBE" data-sfc-cp="" data-hveid="CAEIGBAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true"><strong class="Yjhzub" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">总结：</strong><br data-serialized-params="[]" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">缓存行是 CPU 与内存之间的“物流集装箱”。优秀的程序员会通过优化数据布局，让这个集装箱装满最有用的东西，从而让 CPU 始终满载运行，而不是在漫长的等待中浪费周期。</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
